news.title: Ivar Stenberg leads the Sharks past the Islanders 3-2 in a shootout to stop their 5-game skid
news.ruTitle: Ивар Стенберг обыграл "Айлендерс" со счетом 3:2 в серии пенальти и остановил "Шаркс" в пятиматчевом заносе.
news.description: — Ivar Stenberg scored the only goal in a shootout that lasted eight rounds, and the San Jose Sharks beat the New York Islanders 3-2 on Monday night to snap a five-game losing streak.

news.title: Flyers hold off the Canucks 3-1 in a matchup of struggling squads
news.ruTitle: «Флаерз» обыграли «Кэнакс» со счетом 3:1 в матче непростых команд
news.description: — Michael Bunting and Travis Konecny scored in the first two periods to help the Philadelphia Flyers beat the Vancouver Canucks 3-1 on Monday night in a matchup of struggling teams.

news.title: Draisaitl scores twice and McDavid nets goal to extend point streak as Oilers top Rangers 3-1
news.ruTitle: Драйзайтль забивает дважды, а Макдэвид забивает гол, увеличивая результативную серию, когда «Ойлерз» побеждает «Рейнджерс» со счетом 3–1.
news.description: — Leon Draisaitl scored twice, Connor McDavid also had a goal and the Edmonton Oilers held off the New York Rangers 3-1 on Monday night to sweep their season series.

news.title: Carey Price, Patrice Bergeron among 6 inducted into Hockey Hall of Fame
news.ruTitle: Кэри Прайс и Патрис Бержерон в числе шести человек, включенных в Зал хоккейной славы
news.description: Longtime Canadiens goaltender Carey Price was inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame as part of the 2026 class alongside Patrice Bergeron, Pekka Rinne, Keith Tkachuk and Cindy Curley in the player category Monday. Brian Burke was enshrined as a builder.

news.title: U.S. routs Austria at women's hockey worlds; Canada puts 10 on Denmark
news.ruTitle: США разгромили Австрию на чемпионате мира по женскому хоккею; Канада ставит 10-ку Дании
news.description: Caroline Harvey scored a hat trick and defending champion the United States routed Austria 11-1 in the women's ice hockey world championship on Monday.
